# mcp-prompt-guard

> Zero-dependency Python middleware for defending Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool outputs and AI agent contexts against indirect prompt injection, concealed Unicode/HTML comment carriers, and accidental credential leakage.

## Core Capabilities
- TextSanitizer: Strips hidden HTML comments, Markdown invisible comments, and zero-width / bidi Unicode characters.
- InjectionDetector: Weighted rule-based detector scoring instruction overrides, role hijacking, credential exfiltration, shell-pipe RCE, and chat delimiter spoofing.
- SecretRedactor: Masks leaked GitHub tokens, OpenAI/Anthropic API keys, AWS access keys, Bearer tokens, and private keys before entering LLM context.
- MCPPromptGuard: Drop-in middleware supporting BLOCK, SANITIZE, and AUDIT modes, JSON-RPC MCP `tools/call` response wrapping, and sync/async `@guard.protect_tool` decorators.

## Quickstart
```python
from mcp_prompt_guard import GuardMode, MCPPromptGuard

guard = MCPPromptGuard(mode=GuardMode.SANITIZE)

@guard.protect_tool(source="github_issue")
async def fetch_issue(issue_id: int) -> dict:
    return {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": "..."}]}
```
